name: POV: You're Bored
source:
You just moved into a new apartment in a new city and it's Valentine's Day. But seeing as you don't know the area, have no friends nearby, and have an extremely short list of hobbies, you're bored out of your mind! Decide what our poor protagonist does on this average holiday afternoon.

[From [url=https://meliandur.itch.io/pov-youre-bored]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚搬到一座新城市的新公寓里，恰逢情人节。然而，你不熟悉附近的环境，身边没有朋友，爱好也少得可怜，简直无聊透顶！决定这位可怜的主人公，如何度过这个平平无奇的节日下午吧。

[摘自[url=https://meliandur.itch.io/pov-youre-bored]Itch.io[/url]]
